cards.t: Chapter overview and the Network Engineer
cards.tz: 本章概览与网络工程师
cards.en:
Idea: Core C taught the parts of a network (router, switch, DNS). This chapter shows how those parts are put together so a real web application can run and people can share printers, files and the Internet.

  • 6.1 IP address + port number = which service on which computer.
  • 6.2 network services: web, database, file, DHCP, domain controller, proxy.
  • 6.3 sharing hardware, files and the Internet connection.
  • 6.4 building a simple home network.

A network engineer is the person who designs, installs and maintains these networks (servers, cabling, Wi-Fi, security).

Exam wording: A network engineer plans, sets up and maintains network hardware and services so users can reliably share resources.
cards.zh:
直觉：必修 C 学了网络零件（router、switch、DNS）。本章讲怎样把它们组装起来，让 web application 真正运行，并让大家共享打印机、文件和上网。

  • 6.1 IP address + port number 决定是哪台机的哪个服务。
  • 6.2 网络服务：web、database、file、DHCP、domain controller、proxy。
  • 6.3 共享硬件、文件、Internet。
  • 6.4 搭建简单家庭网络。

Network engineer（网络工程师）负责设计、安装和维护网络。

考试写法：Network engineer plans, sets up and maintains network hardware and services。

ex.q: Name three duties of a network engineer in a school.
ex.a:
1. Install and configure switches, access points and servers.
2. Set up user accounts and folder permissions.
3. Monitor and fix network faults, apply security updates.
ex.az: 1. 安装设定 switch、AP、server。2. 建帐户和权限。3. 监察故障、更新保安。

ex.q: Which section would explain why a printer should get a static IP?
ex.a: Section 6.4 (basic network implementation: IP addresses at home). Section 6.3 covers sharing the printer itself.
ex.az: 6.4 讲 static IP；6.3 讲共享打印机。

ex.q: A student says: 'A network engineer writes the PHP code of the school website.' Correct?
ex.a: Wrong. Writing server-side scripts is the job of a web/back-end developer. The network engineer makes sure the web server, database server and network that the code runs on are working and secure.
ex.az: 错：写 PHP 是 web developer 的工作；network engineer 负责服务器和网络运作及安全。

cards.en:
Idea: An IP address is like a building's street address. A port number is like the flat number inside. One computer (building) runs many programs (flats): browser, email, game. The port says which program the data is for.

A port number is a number used to identify different services or applications running on the same network address.

  • Defined by TCP (also used by UDP).
  • Unsigned 16-bit number: 0 to 65535 (216 = 65536 values).
  • When data arrives, the computer checks the port number on the data and directs it to the application on that port.
  • Each networked program listens on its own port.
  • IP address + port together identify one service, e.g. 203.0.113.5:443.

Exam wording: A port number identifies a specific service/application running on a device with the same IP address; it is a 16-bit number from 0 to 65535.
cards.zh:
直觉：IP address 像大厦地址，port 像室号。一部电脑（大厦）同时跑很多程序（单位），port 说明数据交给哪个程序。

Port number：用来识别同一 network address 上不同 service/application 的数字。

  • 由 TCP 定义（UDP 也用）。
  • 16-bit 无号数：0–65535。
  • 每个网络程序占一个 port。
  • IP + port 确定一个服务，如 203.0.113.5:443。

考试写法：Port number identifies a specific service/application running on a device with the same IP address。

ex.q: Why can a 16-bit port number not be 70000?
ex.a:
Steps:
  1. 16 bits gives 216 = 65536 values.
  2. Starting at 0, the largest is 65535.
  3. 70000 > 65535, so it is not a valid port.

ex.q: A PC at 192.168.1.20 runs a browser and a game. Data arrives for 192.168.1.20:3074. Which program gets it?
ex.a: The IP picks the PC; port 3074 (Xbox game) picks the game program. The browser uses a different port.
ex.az: IP 选电脑，port 3074 选游戏程序。

ex.q: 'The port number identifies the computer on the network.' Correct this.
ex.a: Wrong. The IP address identifies the device. The port number identifies the service/application on that device.
ex.az: 错：IP 识别设备，port 识别设备上的服务。

ex.q: Two programs on the same PC both try to listen on port 80. What happens?
ex.a: The second program fails to start (port already in use / port conflict). Only one program can listen on one port for the same protocol, so the second must use another port, e.g. 8080.
ex.az: 第二个程序无法启动（port conflict），须改用其他 port 如 8080。

demo.title: Data finds its program by port

frames.en: A packet for 192.168.1.20 port 443 reaches the PC.
The OS reads destination port 443.
Data goes only to the browser's HTTPS connection.

cards.en:
Idea: TCP is like registered mail: signed for, resent if lost, arrives in order. UDP is like shouting across a room: fast, but if someone misses a word, nobody repeats it.

TCPUDP
Reliabilityconnection-based, error checking, lost data resent, in orderno mandatory error checking, lost packets not resent
Speedmore overheadlower latency
Typical useweb (HTTP/HTTPS), email (SMTP), file transferVoIP, DNS look-ups, online gaming, live streaming

Both are transport layer protocols above IP and both use port numbers.

Exam wording: Use TCP when all data must arrive correctly and in order; use UDP when low latency matters more than losing a few packets.
cards.zh:
直觉：TCP 像挂号信：要签收、遗失会重寄、按次序。UDP 像大声喊：快，但漏听了没人重复。

TCPUDP
可靠性connection-based，错误检查，重传，有序无强制检查，不重传
速度overhead 较大latency 较低
用途网页、电邮、文件传输VoIP、DNS、游戏、直播

两者都是 IP 之上的 transport layer protocol，都用 port。

考试写法：TCP when all data must arrive correctly and in order；UDP when low latency matters more。

ex.q: Which protocol for downloading a 2 GB installer? Why?
ex.a: TCP. Every byte must be correct; one missing byte breaks the file. TCP resends lost packets and keeps order.
ex.az: TCP：缺一个 byte 文件就坏，TCP 会重传。

ex.q: Which protocol for a live video call? Why?
ex.a: UDP. Low delay matters most. A late resent frame is useless; skipping a lost frame is better.
ex.az: UDP：延迟最重要，重传的旧画面已无用。

ex.q: 'UDP is faster, so it is always better for websites.' Correct?
ex.a: Wrong. A web page with missing parts would display wrongly. Web browsing uses TCP because reliability is required.
ex.az: 错：网页需要完整，故用 TCP。

cards.t: System ports and common port numbers
cards.en:
Idea: Popular services always 'live' at the same flat number so every client knows where to knock. Those fixed numbers are the well-known ports.

Ports 0–1023 are system ports (well-known ports), reserved for widely used services. 1024–65535 are mostly free for other applications.

PortService
20, 21FTP
22SSH
25SMTP
53DNS
80HTTP
110POP3
143IMAP
443HTTPS
1194OpenVPN
3074Xbox game
3306MySQL
3389Microsoft Remote Desktop
5432PostgreSQL

Exam wording: System (well-known) ports 0–1023 are reserved for system processes providing widely used network services, e.g. HTTP 80, HTTPS 443.
cards.zh:
直觉：常用服务固定住在同一「室号」，客户端就知道去哪里敲门。这些就是 well-known ports。

0–1023 是 system ports，保留给常用服务；1024–65535 大多可给其他程序。

Port服务
20, 21FTP
22SSH
25SMTP
53DNS
80HTTP
110POP3
143IMAP
443HTTPS
3306MySQL
3389Remote Desktop
5432PostgreSQL

考试写法：System ports 0–1023 are reserved for widely used network services。

ex.q: A firewall must allow a school website (HTTP and HTTPS) and its MySQL database to be reached by the web server. Which ports?
ex.a: 80 (HTTP), 443 (HTTPS), 3306 (MySQL, only from the web server).

ex.q: Is 8080 a system port?
ex.a: No. 8080 > 1023, so it is in the non-system range. It is a common choice for a second/test web server.

ex.q: A student writes: 'SMTP uses port 110 to send email.' Correct this.
ex.a: Wrong. SMTP = 25 (sending). 110 is POP3 (receiving/downloading mail). IMAP 143 is also for receiving.
ex.az: 错：SMTP 是 25；110 是 POP3（收信）。

cards.t: Assigning ports and default ports in URLs
cards.tz: 指定端口与 URL 默认端口
cards.en:
Idea: If you visit a friend who always lives in flat 443, you don't need to say the flat number. Only when they move to another flat must you write it.

Syntax: protocol://domain:port/path

  • Default port can be left out: https://www.mysite.net → port 443; http://… → 80.
  • Non-default port must be written: https://mysite.net:8080/notice.html.
  • Any free port can be assigned to an application through the OS.

Exam wording: When the default port of the protocol is used, the port number can be omitted from the URL; otherwise it must be specified after a colon.
cards.zh:
直觉：朋友一直住 443 室就不用讲室号；搬了才要写出来。

语法：protocol://domain:port/path

  • 默认 port 可省略：https → 443，http → 80。
  • 非默认要写：https://mysite.net:8080/notice.html。

考试写法：Default port can be omitted; a non-default port must be specified after a colon。

ex.q: Which port does http://shop.example.com/cart.php go to?
ex.a: Protocol http, no port written → default 80.

ex.q: A test web server runs on port 8080 of mysite.net with HTTPS. Write the URL for index.html.
ex.a: https://mysite.net:8080/index.html — port goes after the domain, before the path.
ex.az: port 放在 domain 之后、path 之前。

ex.q: A student writes https://mysite.net/8080/index.html. What is wrong?
ex.a: Wrong: '/8080' is read as a folder on port 443. The port must follow a colon: https://mysite.net:8080/index.html.
ex.az: 错：/8080 被当成文件夹；port 要用冒号。

ex.q: Is https://mysite.net:443/ valid?
ex.a: Yes. It is the same as https://mysite.net/; writing the default port is allowed but unnecessary.

cards.t: Reasons for using a non-default port
cards.tz: 使用非默认端口的原因
cards.en:
Idea: Sometimes the usual flat is already taken, or you want to hide, or you need two of the same shop. Then you use another flat number.

  1. Port conflict: the default port is already used by another application of the same protocol.
  2. Security: a non-default port obfuscates the service, harder for attackers scanning default ports.
  3. Multiple instances: two instances of one service on one domain (e.g. live and testing web servers) cannot share a port.
  4. Network restrictions: an ISP/firewall may block a default port, so another port is used.

Exam wording: Reasons: port conflict; security by obfuscation; running multiple instances of the same service; default port blocked by ISP/firewall.
cards.zh:
直觉：默认室已被占、想隐藏、或要开两间同类店，就换别的室号。

  1. Port conflict：默认 port 已被同协议程序占用。
  2. 保安：非默认 port 令扫描默认 port 的攻击者较难找到。
  3. 多个实例：同域名两个 web server（正式＋测试）不能共用 port。
  4. 网络限制：ISP/防火墙封了默认 port。

考试写法：port conflict / security obfuscation / multiple instances / default port blocked。

ex.q: A company runs its public site on 443 and a staff testing site on the same server. Suggest a port and the reason.
ex.a: Use e.g. 8443 or 8080. Reason: multiple instances of the web server cannot share port 443.
ex.az: 用 8443；原因：多个实例不能共用 443。

ex.q: Why might an admin move SSH from 22 to 2222?
ex.a: Security: automated attacks scan port 22; a non-default port hides the service from simple scans.

ex.q: 'Using a non-default port makes the server fully secure.' Correct?
ex.a: Wrong. It only obfuscates; a full port scan still finds it. Strong passwords, updates and a firewall are still needed.
ex.az: 错：只是隐藏，仍需密码、更新、防火墙。

cards.en:
Idea: A web server is like a restaurant waiter: the client (browser) orders a page, the waiter brings it, either ready-made (static file) or cooked fresh (PHP).

A web server is an application that delivers web content (pages, images, videos, files) when clients request them. It handles HTTP requests and returns HTTP responses.

  • Static: returns files directly from a folder.
  • Dynamic: runs server-side scripts (e.g. PHP), often querying a database, to build the page.
  • Listens on port 80/443.
  • Software examples: Apache, NGINX, IIS.

Exam wording: A web server receives HTTP requests from clients and returns HTTP responses containing web content; it may run server-side scripts to generate pages dynamically.
cards.zh:
直觉：Web server 像侍应：浏览器点菜（请求网页），侍应送上现成的（静态文件）或即煮的（PHP）。

Web server：在客户端请求时提供网页内容的程序，处理 HTTP request，回传 HTTP response。

  • 静态：直接回传文件。
  • 动态：执行 PHP 等脚本（常查数据库）生成网页。
  • Port 80/443。
  • 软件：Apache、NGINX、IIS。

考试写法：Web server receives HTTP requests and returns HTTP responses; may run server-side scripts to generate pages dynamically。

ex.q: A browser requests logo.png. What does the web server do?
ex.a:
1. Receives HTTP GET /logo.png on port 443.
2. Finds the file in its folder.
3. Sends an HTTP response (status 200) with the image data.

ex.q: A browser requests products.php. What does the web server do?
ex.a:
1. Receives the request.
2. Passes products.php to the PHP interpreter.
3. The script queries the database server and builds HTML.
4. The web server returns the resulting HTML (not the PHP code).
ex.az: 交 PHP 执行、查数据库、回传 HTML。

ex.q: 'The browser receives the PHP source code and runs it.' Correct?
ex.a: Wrong. PHP runs on the server; the browser only gets the resulting HTML.
ex.az: 错：PHP 在服务器执行，浏览器只收 HTML。

frames.en: Browser sends GET /products.php to web server port 443.
frames.zh: 浏览器向 web server 443 port 发请求。

frames.en: PHP script sends SQL to database server port 3306.
Database returns the query result.
Web server sends the generated HTML back.

cards.en:
Idea: The database server is the kitchen store room. Customers never walk in; only the waiter (server-side script) fetches what is needed.

A database server uses a DBMS to manage multiple databases, each with tables, constraints and data.

  • End-users rarely touch it directly.
  • A server-side script sends a query → server executes → returns the result.
  • MySQL default port 3306.
  • Security: user authentication (account + password) and access control (privileges per database/table, e.g. SELECT only).

Exam wording: A database server uses a DBMS to manage databases, executes queries sent by server-side scripts and returns the results; protected by authentication and access control.
cards.zh:
直觉：数据库服务器像厨房仓库：客人不会进去，只有侍应（服务器脚本）去拿。

Database server 用 DBMS 管理多个数据库。

  • 用户很少直接接触。
  • 脚本送 query → 执行 → 回传结果。
  • MySQL 默认 3306。
  • 保安：authentication 与 access control（如只准 SELECT）。

考试写法：uses a DBMS to manage databases, executes queries from server-side scripts and returns results。

ex.q: A web app only needs to show products. What privileges should its DB account have?
ex.a: Only SELECT on the products table. Least privilege: if the script is hacked, data cannot be changed or deleted.

ex.q: Where should the MySQL port 3306 be reachable from?
ex.a: Only from the web server (or admin network), not the whole Internet, to reduce attacks.
ex.az: 只让 web server 存取。

ex.q: 'Users log in to the database server from their browser to see products.' Correct?
ex.a: Wrong. Browsers talk to the web server. The server-side script connects to the database with its own account and turns results into HTML.
ex.az: 错：浏览器只连 web server，脚本才连数据库。

cards.en:
Idea: A file server is a shared cupboard for the whole office, with a lock on each drawer, so everybody saves to one place instead of their own desk.

A file server provides a centralised location for shared file access within a network, organised as folders and sub-folders.

  • User authentication: log in with username/password.
  • User access control: permissions per user/group per file/folder.
PermissionOn a file
Readopen and view content
Writechange content
Executerun the file (programs/scripts)

Exam wording: A file server provides a centralised location for shared file access within a network, using user authentication and access control (read/write/execute permissions).
cards.zh:
直觉：File server 像全公司共用的柜，每个抽屉有锁，大家都存在同一处。

File server：网络内集中共享文件的位置，以文件夹层级组织。

  • Authentication：帐号密码登入。
  • Access control：按用户/组设权限。
权限对文件
Read打开阅读
Write修改内容
Execute执行程序

考试写法：provides a centralised location for shared file access，配合 authentication 与 access control。

ex.q: A teacher should view but not change the exam timetable file. Which permissions?
ex.a: Read only (no Write, no Execute).

ex.q: Give two benefits of a file server for a 30-staff office.
ex.a:
1. Centralised storage: one place to back up.
2. Easy sharing and access control by user/group.
ex.az: 集中备份；易于共享与控制。

ex.q: 'Read permission lets a user run setup.exe.' Correct?
ex.a: Wrong. Running a program needs Execute permission. Read only lets you view/copy the content.
ex.az: 错：执行要 Execute 权限。

cards.t: Folder permissions and the school example
cards.tz: 文件夹权限与学校例子
cards.en:
Idea: A folder is a room. 'Read' lets you look at the name labels on the boxes inside; 'Write' lets you add, remove or rename boxes.

PermissionOn a folder
Readlist names of files/sub-folders (to open a file you also need Read on that file)
Writecreate, delete or rename files in the folder

Book example:

  • admin: full permissions everywhere.
  • teacher: Public = Read only; ICT and Exam_Result = Read + Write; no Execute.
  • student: Public = Read; own folder Read + Write; no access to Exam_Result.

Exam wording: Grant only the minimum permissions needed (principle of least privilege) to prevent unauthorised access and accidental modification/deletion.
cards.zh:
直觉：文件夹像房间：Read 可看箱上的名牌；Write 可加、移除、改名箱子。

权限对文件夹
Read列出内容名称（打开文件还要该文件的 Read）
Write新增、删除、改名文件
  • admin：全部权限。
  • teacher：Public 只读；ICT、Exam_Result 读写；无 Execute。
  • student：Public 只读；自己文件夹读写；不能进 Exam_Result。

考试写法：Grant only the minimum permissions needed，防止未经授权存取及误删。

ex.q: Why give teachers only Read on Public?
ex.a: So they cannot delete or change shared files by mistake; only the admin maintains them.

ex.q: A student must hand in homework to ICT/Submit but not see others' work. Set the permissions.
ex.a: Write on Submit folder (can add files); no Read on the folder (cannot list others' files).

ex.q: 'Read on a folder lets me open every file in it.' Correct?
ex.a: Wrong. Folder Read only lists names. Opening a file also needs Read on that file.
ex.az: 错：只能列出名称；打开文件需该文件的 Read。

cards.tz: File server 与云端储存比较
cards.en:
Idea: Owning a file server is like buying a car: big cost first, cheap later, you do the repairs. Cloud storage is like renting: quick start, monthly fee forever.

Cloud storage examples: OneDrive, Google Drive. The first five rows below are the book's table; the last three are extra.

AspectFile serverCloud storage
Setuphigher cost and timequick and easy
Long-run costcheaper per unitsubscription, dearer long term
Scalabilityneeds expertiseeasy, up to provider's plan
Access speedfaster inside LANdepends on Internet
Control/privacyfull control, data stays on sitedata held by provider
Remote accessneeds VPN setupanywhere with Internet
Maintenanceown staffprovider

Exam wording: File server: faster LAN access and full control of data, but higher setup cost and needs technical staff. Cloud: easy to set up, scale and access anywhere, but ongoing fees and reliance on the Internet/provider.
cards.zh:
直觉：自设 file server 像买车：先付大钱、长远便宜、自己维修。云端像租车：即开即用、月月付费。

方面File serverCloud
设立成本与时间高快、易
长期成本单位较便宜订阅较贵
扩展需专业容易
速度LAN 内较快视乎 Internet
控制完全控制在供应商
远程需 VPN随处可用

考试写法：File server faster LAN access, full control, higher setup cost；Cloud easy to scale/access anywhere, ongoing fees, needs Internet。

ex.q: A design firm edits 50 GB video files daily in the office. Which? Why?
ex.a: File server: LAN speed is much faster than uploading/downloading 50 GB over the Internet, and long-term cost per GB is lower.

ex.q: A 3-person start-up works from home. Which? Why?
ex.a: Cloud storage: no hardware or IT staff, quick setup, access from anywhere.
ex.az: 云端：无需硬件、随处存取。

ex.q: 'Cloud storage needs no Internet because files are synced.' Correct?
ex.a: Wrong. Synced copies can be used offline, but uploading, sharing and getting others' changes need Internet; an outage blocks access to the cloud.
ex.az: 错：同步与共享需要 Internet。

cards.en:
Idea: DHCP is like a hotel front desk handing out room keys: you arrive, get a free room for a fixed time, and the key goes back to the pool when you leave.

A DHCP (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol) server assigns IP addresses to devices dynamically.

  • Scope: the range of IPs it may give, e.g. 192.168.0.96–192.168.0.200.
  • New device sends a DHCP request → server gives an unused IP from the scope.
  • Lease: each IP is given for a fixed time (e.g. 24 h); the device must renew, else the IP returns to the pool.
  • Also gives subnet mask, default gateway, DNS server.

Exam wording: A DHCP server automatically assigns IP addresses (and network settings) from a defined scope to devices for a lease duration.
cards.zh:
直觉：DHCP 像酒店前台派房卡：来了就分空房，有限期，退房后卡回到池中。

DHCP server 动态分配 IP。

  • Scope：可分配的 IP 范围。
  • 新设备请求 → 分配未用 IP。
  • Lease：租期（如 24 小时），要续租。
  • 同时提供 subnet mask、gateway、DNS。

考试写法：automatically assigns IP addresses from a defined scope for a lease duration。

ex.q: Scope is 192.168.0.96 to 192.168.0.200. How many devices can get an address?
A lab has 40 PCs but scope holds only 30 addresses. What happens to the 31st PC?
ex.a: No free IP: it cannot get an address and cannot use the network. Fix: enlarge the scope or shorten leases.
ex.az: 第 31 部拿不到 IP；扩大 scope。

ex.q: 'Scope 192.168.0.96–200 has 104 addresses (200 − 96).' Correct?
ex.a: Wrong — off by one. Both ends count: 200 − 96 + 1 = 105.

cards.en:
Idea: A new student doesn't know where the office is, so she shouts 'Who gives out lockers?' Only the office replies.

Four messages (DORA):

  1. Discover: new PC broadcasts to all devices (it does not know the server's IP).
  2. Offer: only the DHCP server replies with an offered IP, subnet mask, gateway, DNS.
  3. Request: PC asks for the offered address.
  4. Acknowledge: server confirms; IP is leased.

Exam wording: The client broadcasts a DHCP discover message; the server replies with a DHCP offer; the client sends a DHCP request; the server sends an acknowledgement and the IP is leased.
cards.zh:
直觉：新生不知道校务处在哪，就大喊「谁派储物柜？」，只有校务处回应。

  1. Discover：新电脑广播。
  2. Offer：只有 DHCP server 回应，附 IP、mask、gateway、DNS。
  3. Request：电脑请求该地址。
  4. Acknowledge：确认，开始租用。

考试写法：broadcasts DHCP discover → offer → request → acknowledgement。

ex.q: Why must Discover be a broadcast?
ex.a: The PC has no IP yet and doesn't know the server's IP, so it sends to everyone; only the DHCP server answers.
ex.az: 不知 server IP，只能广播。

ex.q: List what the Offer contains.
ex.a: Offered IP address, subnet mask, default gateway, DNS server address, lease time, server IP.

ex.q: 'The PC gets its IP as soon as the server sends the Offer.' Correct?
ex.a: Wrong. The PC must still send a Request, and the IP is assigned only after the server's Acknowledge.
ex.az: 错：还要 Request 和 Acknowledge。

frames.en: New PC broadcasts DHCP Discover.
Only DHCP server replies: IP 192.168.0.120, mask, gateway, DNS.
frames.zh: 只有 DHCP 回应 Offer。

frames.en: PC requests 192.168.0.120.
Server confirms; lease starts (e.g. 24 h).

cards.en:
Idea: Automatic key handout is fast and avoids two guests getting the same room, but if the front desk closes, newcomers can't get in.

Advantages

  • Automatic IP assignment: fewer IP conflicts and human errors.
  • Centralised management: mask, gateway, DNS changed in one place.
  • Faster setup: users connect with no configuration.

Disadvantage

  • Single point of failure: if the DHCP server is down, new devices cannot get IPs. (Fix: backup DHCP server.)

Exam wording: Adv: reduces IP conflicts and manual errors; centralised management; faster setup. Disadv: single point of failure.
cards.zh:
直觉：自动派卡快又不会撞房，但前台关门，新客人就进不来。

优点

  • 自动分配：减少 IP conflict 与人为错误。
  • 集中管理。
  • 设定快。

缺点

  • Single point of failure：DHCP 失效，新设备拿不到 IP。

考试写法：reduces IP conflicts; centralised management; faster setup / single point of failure。

ex.q: The school changes its DNS server. Why is DHCP helpful?
ex.a: Update the DNS setting once on the DHCP server; every device gets it when it renews its lease. No visiting 500 PCs.
ex.az: 只需在 DHCP 改一次。

ex.q: The DHCP server crashes. Which devices are affected first?
ex.a: New devices and those whose lease expires: they cannot get/renew an IP. Devices with valid leases keep working for now.
ex.az: 新设备和租期届满的设备。

ex.q: 'If the DHCP server fails, every device goes offline at once.' Correct?
ex.a: Not exactly. Devices keep their current IP until the lease expires; problems appear for new devices and on renewal.

cards.en:
Idea: A domain controller is the school's single ID-card system: one card opens the doors you're allowed through, on any campus building.

A domain controller implements login authentication and user rights control for a network.

  • Stores all user accounts; one account works on every computer in the domain.
  • Sets access rights to domain resources (file server, printers) per user/group.
  • Book's three advantages: Centralised user and resource management; Improved security (manages authentication and authorisation, enforces access control rules); Group Policy management (admins set system settings, security policies and software installs across the whole network).
  • (Beyond the book) a possible drawback: single point of failure.

Exam wording: A domain controller centrally authenticates users logging in to any computer in the network and controls their access rights to network resources.
cards.zh:
直觉：Domain controller 像学校统一的学生证：一张卡可在任何大楼开你有权进入的门。

Domain controller 负责登入认证与用户权限控制。

  • 集中储存帐户，一个帐户可在任何电脑登入。
  • 按用户/组设定资源存取权。
  • 优点：集中管理、统一保安政策。
  • 缺点：单点故障；需专人管理。

考试写法：centrally authenticates users and controls their access rights to network resources。

课本三个优点：集中管理用户与资源（Centralised user and resource management）；提高安全性（Improved security）；Group Policy 管理（统一设定系统设置、安全策略、软件安装）。

ex.q: A student leaves the school. Why is a domain controller useful?
ex.a: Disable one account on the domain controller; access to all PCs, file server and printers is removed at once.

ex.q: Student Tom Ho logs in on lab PC 12 then library PC 3. What makes this possible?
ex.a: Both PCs check his credentials with the domain controller, so the same account works everywhere.
ex.az: 两部电脑都向 domain controller 认证。

ex.q: 'A domain controller assigns IP addresses to PCs.' Correct?
ex.a: Wrong. That is the DHCP server. A domain controller handles authentication and user rights.
ex.az: 错：派 IP 是 DHCP 的工作。

ex.q: Give the book's three advantages of a domain controller.
ex.a: Centralised user and resource management; improved security; Group Policy management.
ex.az: 集中管理用户与资源；提高安全性；Group Policy 管理。

cards.en:
Idea: A proxy is like a class monitor who fetches books from the library for everyone. If someone already borrowed that book, the monitor hands over the copy on the desk instead of walking to the library again.

A proxy server is an intermediary between a network and the Internet. Main benefits: content caching and content filtering.

  1. PC A requests https://mysite.net/application.html.
  2. Proxy intercepts and sends an identical request using its own IP.
  3. Response returns; proxy forwards it to PC A and saves a copy (cache).
  4. PC B requests the same page; proxy returns the cached copy without contacting the server.

Exam wording: Caching: the proxy stores copies of frequently requested resources so later requests are served locally, giving faster load times and reduced bandwidth usage.
cards.zh:
直觉：Proxy 像班长替全班去图书馆借书；已借过的书，直接把桌上那本给你。

Proxy server：网络与 Internet 之间的中间人，主要好处：caching 与 filtering。

  1. PC A 请求网页。
  2. Proxy 拦截，用自己的 IP 发出同样请求。
  3. 收到回应，转给 PC A 并储存副本。
  4. PC B 请求同一页，直接给缓存副本。

考试写法：stores copies of frequently requested resources; faster load times and reduced bandwidth。

ex.q: 30 students open the same 2 MB page. Without proxy vs with caching proxy, how much Internet traffic?
ex.a: Without: 30 × 2 = 60 MB. With: first request 2 MB, then 29 served from cache → 2 MB.
ex.az: 无 proxy 60 MB；有 proxy 2 MB。

ex.q: What IP does mysite.net see for these requests?
ex.a: The proxy's IP, not the students' PCs.

ex.q: 'The cached copy is stored on PC A's hard disk and shared with PC B.' Correct?
ex.a: Wrong. The cache is stored on the proxy server; PC B gets it from the proxy.

frames.en: PC A asks for application.html.
Proxy sends the same request with its own IP.
frames.zh: Proxy 用自己 IP 转发。

frames.en: Response comes back; proxy saves a copy and forwards it to A.
PC B requests the same page; proxy answers from cache, no Internet traffic.
frames.zh: PC B 直接由缓存取得。

cards.t: Content filtering and proxy vs firewall
cards.tz: Content filtering 及 proxy 与 firewall
cards.en:
Idea: All requests pass the proxy, like all letters passing a mail room, so it can refuse to send letters to certain addresses. A firewall is the security guard at the gate checking every package in and out by rules.

Content filtering: the proxy blocks requests to certain domains (violent, indecent, time-wasting sites).

Proxy serverFirewall
Main purposecaching, blocking websites, hiding client IPsprotecting network from threats by allowing/blocking traffic by rules (ports, addresses)
Directionmostly outgoing requestsincoming and outgoing
Levelapplication (e.g. web)network/transport (packets)

Exam wording: A proxy filters content by intercepting requests to blocked domains; a firewall protects the network by allowing or blocking traffic according to security rules.
cards.zh:
直觉：所有请求经过 proxy，像所有信件经过收发室，可拒寄到某些地址。Firewall 是门口保安，按规则检查进出。

Content filtering：proxy 拦截前往某些域名的请求。

ProxyFirewall
目的缓存、封网站、隐藏 IP按规则允许/阻挡流量保护网络
方向主要对外请求进出皆有

考试写法：Proxy filters content by intercepting requests；firewall allows/blocks traffic by security rules。

ex.q: A school wants to stop students visiting game sites. Proxy or firewall?
ex.a: Proxy content filtering: block requests to those domains.

ex.q: A company wants to block all incoming connections to port 3389 from the Internet. Proxy or firewall?
ex.a: Firewall: rule-based blocking of incoming traffic by port.

ex.q: 'A proxy server is the same as a firewall.' Correct?
ex.a: Wrong. A proxy mainly caches/filters outgoing web requests; a firewall protects against threats by rules on all traffic.

cards.t: Advantages and disadvantages of a proxy server
cards.en:
Idea: Having a middle-man hides who you are and can save trips, but every message takes one extra stop.

Advantages

  • Anonymity/privacy: destination sees the proxy's IP, masking clients.
  • Improved performance: caching → faster loads, less bandwidth.
  • Content filtering.

Disadvantages

  • Latency: extra hop, worse if far away or uncached.
  • Security risk: a poorly protected proxy can be exploited to intercept data.
  • Complexity and maintenance: setting up and maintaining a proxy (configuration, updates, security) takes time and skill, especially for large networks.
  • Not a disadvantage per the book: outdated content, because servers send last-modified/expiry (or no-cache) headers.

Exam wording: Adv: masks client IP; faster load and lower bandwidth by caching. Disadv: extra latency; a poorly secured proxy can be exploited.
cards.zh:
直觉：中间人可隐藏身分、省路程，但每个讯息多停一站。

优点

  • 匿名：目的地只见 proxy IP。
  • 效能：缓存加快、省频宽。
  • 过滤。

缺点

  • Latency：多一跳。
  • 保安风险：可被利用拦截数据。

考试写法：masks client IP; caching faster / extra latency; can be exploited。

课本第三个缺点：Complexity and maintenance（设置和维护复杂耗时）。“内容过时”按课本不算缺点（服务器有 expiry/no-cache header）。

ex.q: A user in Hong Kong uses a proxy in Brazil. Effect on speed?
ex.a: Higher latency: every request travels to Brazil and back before reaching the site.

ex.q: Why might a website not know which student visited it?
ex.a: Requests carry the proxy's IP, not the student's.

ex.q: 'A proxy always makes browsing faster.' Correct?
ex.a: Wrong. Only cached content is faster. Uncached requests are slower because of the extra hop.
ex.az: 错：未缓存的内容反而较慢。

ex.q: A student writes 'disadvantage: users always get outdated pages'. Accept?
ex.a: No. Servers attach last-modified/expiry headers (or no-cache), so the proxy knows when to fetch a fresh copy. Use latency, security risk or complexity and maintenance instead.
ex.az: 不接受。服务器附 expiry/no-cache header。应答延迟、安全风险或维护复杂。

cards.t: Misconception: proxies always serve outdated content
cards.tz: 误解：proxy 一定给过时内容
cards.en:
Idea: Milk has an expiry date on the carton. The proxy is told how long each page stays 'fresh', so it throws stale copies away.

  • Web server adds last-modified and expiry headers → proxy caches only until expiry, then fetches fresh.
  • For time-sensitive or personal resources (live scores, shopping cart) the server sends a no-cache header → proxy does not reuse it.

Exam wording: The web server controls caching through HTTP response headers (last-modified, expiry, no-cache), so clients do not always receive outdated content.
cards.zh:
直觉：牛奶盒上有到期日；proxy 也被告知每页「新鲜」多久，过期就丢掉。

  • Server 加 last-modified 和 expiry header，过期就重新取。
  • 即时或个人资料加 no-cache，proxy 不重用。

考试写法：Web server controls caching through HTTP response headers。

ex.q: A news page has expiry 10 minutes. A request comes at minute 4 and another at minute 12. What happens?
ex.a: Minute 4: served from cache. Minute 12: expired → proxy fetches a fresh copy from the server, caches it again.
ex.az: 第 4 分钟用缓存；第 12 分钟重新取。

ex.q: Which header for a user's shopping cart page? Why?
ex.a: no-cache: the cart is personal and changes; another user must never get this copy.

ex.q: 'Caching proxies always give old pages, so schools should never use them.' Correct?
ex.a: Wrong. Headers set by the server control freshness; correctly configured caching gives fresh content and saves bandwidth.

cards.tz: 共享资源的好处与硬件共享
cards.en:
Idea: One good printer for the whole office is cheaper and easier to look after than one printer on every desk.

Sharing saves cost and simplifies management. Shared resources: hardware, files, Internet connection.

Network printer: connects directly to the network (Ethernet/Wi-Fi), has its own IP address; users send jobs straight to it.

  • Pros: easy setup, no PC needs to stay on.
  • Cons: each printer managed separately; needs built-in networking.

Exam wording: Sharing hardware reduces cost (fewer devices needed) and centralises maintenance. A network printer has its own IP address and network interface, so users print to it directly.
cards.zh:
直觉：全公司共用一部好打印机，比每张桌一部更便宜、易管理。

共享可省钱、易管理：硬件、文件、Internet。

Network printer：直接接上网络，有自己的 IP。

  • 优：易设定，不需电脑长开。
  • 缺：每部分开管理；需内置网络功能。

考试写法：reduces cost and centralises maintenance；network printer has its own IP address。

ex.q: An office of 20 staff: 20 desk printers vs 2 network printers. Give two advantages of the second.
ex.a:
1. Lower cost (buy and supply 2 printers).
2. Easier maintenance (toner, repairs in one place).

ex.q: How does a laptop send a job to a network printer?
ex.a: It sends the print job over the LAN to the printer's IP address.

ex.q: 'A network printer must be plugged into a PC by USB to work.' Correct?
ex.a: Wrong. It has its own Ethernet/Wi-Fi interface and IP; no host PC is needed.

cards.en:
Idea: A print server is like a dispatcher at a taxi rank: all jobs go to the dispatcher, who sends each to a free taxi (printer).

A print server is a device or software that manages multiple printers: jobs go to it first, then it dispatches them to available printers. Printers may connect by Ethernet, USB or serial; it monitors status (paper, toner, errors).

Network printerPrint server
Connectioneach printer directly on networkprinters attached to the server
Managementeach separatelycentralised, queue, status
Non-network printerscannot sharecan share
Failureone printer onlyserver down → all printing stops

Exam wording: A print server receives all print jobs and dispatches them to available printers, providing centralised printer management and allowing printers without built-in networking to be shared.
cards.zh:
直觉：Print server 像的士站调度员：所有工作先到他，再派给空闲的的士。

Print server：管理多部打印机，工作先送到它，再分派给可用打印机；可监察纸张、碳粉。

Network printerPrint server
连接各自上网接到 server
管理分开集中
旧打印机不能共享可共享

考试写法：receives all print jobs and dispatches them; centralised management; shares non-network printers。

ex.q: A school has 6 old USB printers. How can all staff share them?
ex.a: Connect them to a print server, which is on the network and dispatches jobs.

ex.q: Printer 1 is out of paper. How does a print server help?
ex.a: It detects the status and sends new jobs to another available printer, and alerts the admin.
ex.az: 改派给其他打印机并通知管理员。

ex.q: 'A print server is just a printer with Wi-Fi.' Correct?
ex.a: Wrong. That describes a network printer. A print server is a separate device/software that manages many printers.

cards.tz: 共享文件与 Internet 连线
cards.en:
Idea: Sharing a cupboard needs locks, a backup copy, and rules. Sharing one Internet line needs a router and enough bandwidth for everyone.

Sharing files (file/database server) — consider:

  • Security: authentication, access control, update OS/software against malware.
  • Permissions: grant only necessary rights → data integrity.
  • Backup and recovery: against hardware failure, accidental deletion, ransomware.

Sharing the Internet connection: one ISP line shared through a router; consider bandwidth (enough for all users), and controls such as filtering by a proxy.

Exam wording: Consider security (authentication, access control, updates), least-privilege permissions, and regular backup; an Internet line is shared through a router with sufficient bandwidth.
cards.zh:
直觉：共用柜要有锁、备份和规则；共用一条上网线要有 router 和足够频宽。

共享文件须考虑：

  • 保安：认证、存取控制、更新。
  • 权限：只给必要权限。
  • 备份与复原。

共享 Internet：经 router，注意频宽。

考试写法：security, least-privilege permissions, regular backup；router + sufficient bandwidth。

ex.q: Ransomware encrypts the shared folder. What saves the data?
ex.a: A recent offline/off-site backup to restore from.

ex.q: A family of 5 streams 4K video (25 Mbps each) at once. Is a 100 Mbps plan enough?
ex.a: 5 × 25 = 125 Mbps > 100 Mbps → not enough; video will buffer.

ex.q: 'Giving everyone full permissions makes sharing easier, so it is best.' Correct?
ex.a: Wrong. It risks accidental or malicious deletion. Give only necessary permissions.

cards.t: Network scale and a simple home network
cards.tz: 网络规模与简单家庭网络
cards.en:
Idea: Data from the Internet is like water from the mains: the modem is the meter, the router is the main valve, the switch and access point split it to each tap.

Networks range from a few home devices to a university with hundreds of PCs plus print, file, DHCP servers and domain controller.

  • Modem: connects to the ISP line.
  • Router: connects the home LAN to the Internet, forwards packets; usually runs DHCP.
  • Switch: connects wired devices.
  • Access point: connects Wi-Fi devices.

Exam wording: Internet → ISP → modem → router → switch (wired) / access point (wireless) → devices.
cards.zh:
直觉：互联网数据像自来水：modem 是水表，router 是总掣，switch 和 AP 分到每个水喉。

  • Modem：接 ISP。
  • Router：连接家中 LAN 与 Internet，通常有 DHCP。
  • Switch：有线设备。
  • Access point：Wi-Fi 设备。

考试写法：Internet → ISP → modem → router → switch / access point → 设备。

ex.q: A PC is wired to the switch; a phone uses Wi-Fi. Trace a web request from the phone.
ex.a: Phone → access point → router → modem → ISP → Internet server.

ex.q: Which device gives home devices their IP addresses?
ex.a: Usually the router (built-in DHCP server).

ex.q: 'The switch connects the home to the Internet.' Correct?
ex.a: Wrong. The router (with modem) connects LAN to Internet; a switch only joins devices within the LAN.
ex.az: 错：switch 只连接 LAN 内设备。

frames.en: Wired PC and printer on the switch; phones on the access point.
frames.zh: 有线设备接 switch，手机接 AP。

frames.en: Phone request goes AP → router → modem → ISP.
Router forwards the response to the phone's private IP.

cards.t: Connecting to the ISP with PPPoE
cards.en:
Idea: PPPoE is like showing your gym membership card at the door: only paying members get in, and you then get a locker (IP address).

PPPoE (Point-to-Point Protocol over Ethernet):

  1. ISP gives the subscriber a username and password; enter them in the router.
  2. Router connects; ISP authenticates the credentials.
  3. If valid, ISP assigns an IP address (the router's public IP).
  4. Home devices access the Internet through the router.

Exam wording: With PPPoE, the ISP authenticates the subscriber's username and password and then assigns a public IP address, so only paying subscribers can access the service.
cards.zh:
直觉：PPPoE 像健身室门口出示会员证：只有付费会员能进，然后分你一个储物柜（IP）。

  1. ISP 给用户名和密码，输入 router。
  2. Router 连线，ISP 认证。
  3. 成功后 ISP 分配 IP（公共 IP）。
  4. 家中设备经 router 上网。

考试写法：ISP authenticates the username and password then assigns a public IP；只有付费用户可用。

ex.q: After setting up a new router, nobody can get online but Wi-Fi works. Likely cause?
ex.a: PPPoE username/password not entered or wrong → ISP authentication fails → no public IP.
ex.az: PPPoE 帐密错误，认证失败。

ex.q: Which IP does a website see when a home phone visits it?
ex.a: The router's public IP assigned by the ISP, not the phone's private IP.

ex.q: 'With PPPoE each phone logs in to the ISP with the password.' Correct?
ex.a: Wrong. Only the router authenticates with the ISP; devices just connect to the router.

frames.en: Username/password typed into the router.
Router sends credentials; ISP checks them.
Valid → ISP assigns public IP e.g. 203.0.113.8.
Home devices reach the Internet through the router.

cards.t: IP addresses at home and static IP
cards.tz: 家中的 IP 分配与 static IP
cards.en:
Idea: Friends find your home by its address. If the printer's address changed every day, nobody could find it.

  • Home router uses DHCP so phones/laptops join automatically.
  • Devices others must find (network printer, NAS, home server) need a static IP that does not change.
  • Set it by DHCP reservation in the router (fixed IP for that device's MAC) or manually on the device, outside the DHCP scope.

Exam wording: A network printer should use a static IP address so that other computers can always locate it; if DHCP changed its IP, print jobs would fail.
cards.zh:
直觉：朋友靠地址找到你家；打印机地址天天变，就没人找到它。

  • Router 用 DHCP，手机电脑自动上网。
  • 打印机、NAS 等要被找到的设备用 static IP。
  • 可在 router 设 DHCP reservation，或在设备手动设定（在 scope 以外）。

考试写法：static IP so other computers can always locate it。

ex.q: Router scope is 192.168.1.100–199. Pick a manual static IP for the printer.
ex.a: e.g. 192.168.1.50: same subnet but outside the scope, so DHCP never gives it to another device.

ex.q: Which home devices need static IPs: phone, printer, smart TV, NAS?
ex.a: Printer and NAS (others connect to them). Phone/TV can use DHCP.

ex.q: A student sets the printer manually to 192.168.1.120, inside the scope 100–199. Problem?
ex.a: Mistake: DHCP may give .120 to another device → IP conflict. Use an address outside the scope or a DHCP reservation.

cards.en:
Idea: Cables are like water pipes: thicker pipes (higher category) carry more, and the slowest pipe limits the whole flow.

CategoryMax throughputMax length
Cat 5100 Mbps100 m
Cat 5E1 Gbps100 m
Cat 61 Gbps / 10 Gbps100 m / 55 m (10 Gbps)

Choose: required speed + length → cheapest category meeting both. The link is limited by its slowest part.

Exam wording: Choose the lowest-cost category that meets both the required throughput and cable length; overall speed is limited by the slowest component.
cards.zh:
直觉：线缆像水管：类别越高流量越大，最窄的一段决定整体流量。

类别最高速度最长
Cat 5100 Mbps100 m
Cat 5E1 Gbps100 m
Cat 61/10 Gbps100 m / 55 m

按速度与长度选最便宜而足够的类别；整条链路受最慢部分限制。

考试写法：lowest-cost category meeting throughput and length；limited by the slowest component。

ex.q: Need 10 Gbps over 40 m. Which cable?
ex.a: Cat 6 (10 Gbps up to 55 m; 40 ≤ 55).

ex.q: Need 1 Gbps over 80 m, cheapest?
ex.a: Cat 5E (1 Gbps, 100 m). Cat 6 also works but costs more.

ex.q: 'Cat 6 at 10 Gbps over 90 m is fine.' Correct?
ex.a: Wrong. 10 Gbps on Cat 6 only up to 55 m; at 90 m it drops to 1 Gbps.

ex.q: 1 Gbps router port, Cat 5 cable to PC. Actual max?
ex.a: 100 Mbps: limited by the Cat 5 cable.

cards.en:
Idea: Wi-Fi is like a radio: put it in the middle of the room, away from walls and noise, and lock it so neighbours can't listen.

  • AP placement: central, away from thick walls, metal, microwaves, cordless phones.
  • Wireless standard: Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) faster, wider coverage; Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac) may be enough.
  • SSID and password: custom SSID, strong password; change default admin password.
  • Encryption: WPA2/WPA3.
  • Dual-band / tri-band: router transmits on 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz (tri-band adds a second 5 GHz band), reducing congestion and interference.

Exam wording: Place the access point centrally away from interference, use a suitable wireless standard, set a custom SSID and strong password with WPA2/WPA3 encryption.
cards.zh:
直觉：Wi-Fi 像收音机：放在中间、远离墙和杂讯，并上锁防邻居偷听。

  • AP 位置：中央，远离厚墙、金属、微波炉。
  • 标准：Wi-Fi 6 较快、覆盖较广。
  • SSID 与密码：自订 SSID、强密码，改预设管理密码。
  • 加密：WPA2/WPA3。

考试写法：central AP, suitable standard, custom SSID, strong password, WPA2/WPA3。

Dual-band / tri-band：同时用 2.4 GHz 和 5 GHz（tri-band 多一个 5 GHz 频段），减少拥挤和干扰。

ex.q: Wi-Fi is weak in the far bedroom. Two fixes?
ex.a:
1. Move the AP to a central position.
2. Add another AP / mesh node (or upgrade to Wi-Fi 6).

ex.q: Why change the default SSID 'TP-Link_1234'?
ex.a: It reveals the router model, helping attackers find default passwords/known flaws.

ex.q: 'Hiding the AP inside a metal cabinet keeps it safe and the signal fine.' Correct?
ex.a: Wrong. Metal blocks/reflects radio waves, weakening the signal. Place it in the open, centrally.

cards.en:
Idea: A home 'router' is like a Swiss Army knife: router, switch and access point in one box.

  • Integrates router + switch + access point (modem often separate).
  • Benefits: lower cost, easier setup.
  • Configured via web interface (e.g. http://192.168.1.1) or app: PPPoE login, SSID/password, DHCP scope, static reservations.
  • Limitation: few switch ports, limited coverage; add switches/APs for bigger homes.

Exam wording: An integrated home router combines a router, a switch and a wireless access point in one device, reducing cost and simplifying setup.
cards.zh:
直觉：家用「router」像瑞士刀：router、switch、AP 三合一。

  • 集成 router + switch + AP（modem 常分开）。
  • 好处：便宜、易设定。
  • 经网页（如 192.168.1.1）或 app 设定 PPPoE、SSID、DHCP、保留 IP。
  • 局限：端口少、覆盖有限。

考试写法：combines router, switch and access point in one device; lower cost, easier setup。

ex.q: Name the 3 functions in a typical home router and what each does.
ex.a: Router: links LAN to Internet. Switch: wired LAN ports. Access point: Wi-Fi.
ex.az: Router 连 Internet；switch 有线；AP 无线。

ex.q: The family needs 8 wired devices but the router has 4 LAN ports. Solution?
ex.a: Connect an extra switch to one router port.

ex.q: 'An integrated router means you never need a modem.' Correct?
ex.a: Not necessarily. The modem connecting to the ISP line is usually separate (or ISP-supplied).

ex.q: Which port does an unlabelled https URL use?
Which server gives out IP addresses?
ex.a: DHCP server.

ex.q: 'Port 3306 is for HTTPS.' Correct?
ex.a: Wrong: 3306 is MySQL; HTTPS is 443.

mc.q: Which of the following is a valid port number?
mc.e: A port is an unsigned 16-bit number, 0 to 65535.
mc.ez: Port 是 16 位无符号数，0–65535。

mc.q: A user enters https://shop.com in a browser. Which destination port receives the HTTP request?
mc.e: No port written, so the HTTPS default 443 is used.
mc.ez: 未写端口即用 HTTPS 默认 443。

mc.q: Which pair is correctly matched?
mc.e: 22 SSH, 110 POP3, 3306 MySQL; 53 is DNS.

mc.q: A company hosts its public website on port 443 and a testing web server on port 8080 of the same domain. Which URL reaches the testing server?
mc.e: A non-default port is written after the domain with a colon.
mc.ez: 非默认端口用冒号写在 domain 后。

mc.q: Which is NOT a reason given for hosting a service on a non-default port?
o: Increasing the bandwidth of the server
mc.e: Changing port does not increase bandwidth.

mc.q: Which range of ports is reserved by TCP as system ports?
mc.e: System (well-known) ports are 0–1023.

mc.q: What is the main purpose of a port number?
o: To identify a service/application on a network address
To identify a device on the Internet
To translate domain names into IP addresses
To encrypt data between client and server
mc.e: IP identifies the device; port identifies the application on it.
mc.ez: IP 找机器，port 找机器上的程序。

mc.q: Which URL sends its request to port 80?
mc.e: HTTP default port is 80.

mc.q: Which protocol uses port 22?
mc.e: Port 22 is SSH (Secure Shell).

mc.q: An email client retrieves mail with POP3. Which port does the mail server listen on?
mc.e: POP3 uses 110 (IMAP 143, SMTP 25).

mc.q: Which statement about UDP is correct?
o: It has lower latency than TCP
It does not use port numbers
It is an application layer protocol
mc.e: UDP is a transport layer protocol with lower latency and no mandatory error checking; it uses ports.
mc.ez: UDP 属 transport layer，延迟低，无强制 error checking，也用 port。

mc.q: Which application is most suitable for UDP?
mc.e: Real-time voice prefers low latency over retransmission.

mc.q: A web server and MySQL run on the same machine 192.168.0.10. Which address reaches MySQL?
mc.e: Same IP, different port; MySQL is 3306.

mc.q: Which allocates a free port to an application on a computer?
mc.e: The book: any application can be assigned a free port through the operating system.
mc.ez: 由 operating system 分配空闲 port。

mc.q: A school firewall blocks port 3389. A staff member's remote desktop service is moved to port 50000. This is mainly due to
mc.e: The default port is blocked by the firewall, so an allowed port is used.
mc.ez: 默认端口被 firewall 封锁。

mc.q: Which is a function of a web server?
o: Handling HTTP requests and producing HTTP responses
mc.e: Definition of a web server.
mc.ez: Web server 处理 HTTP request/response。

mc.q: Which is an example of web server software?
mc.e: NGINX and Apache are web servers; MySQL/PostgreSQL are DBMSs.

mc.q: Which part of an HTTP response indicates whether the request succeeded?
mc.e: e.g. 200 OK is a status code.

mc.q: A web server can generate pages dynamically by
o: running server-side scripts such as PHP
mc.e: Server-side scripts generate dynamic responses.
mc.ez: 执行 server-side script 动态生成。

mc.q: Who usually sends queries to a database server in a web application?
o: A server-side script on the web server
The end-user typing SQL in a browser
mc.e: End-users rarely interact directly; scripts send queries.
mc.ez: 通常由 web server 上的 script 发 query。

mc.q: A database server gives the account web_server_01 permission to SELECT but not DROP tables. This is an example of
mc.e: Different privileges for different accounts = access control.
mc.ez: 不同帐户不同 privilege 属 access control。

mc.q: On a file server, a user has Read permission on a folder but no Read permission on a file inside it. The user can
o: not see the folder at all
mc.e: Folder Read lists names; reading content needs file Read.
mc.ez: 文件夹 Read 只列名字。

mc.q: Write permission on a folder allows a user to
o: edit the content of every file in it
create, delete or rename files in it
mc.e: Folder Write = create/delete/rename files.
mc.ez: Folder Write 可新增、删除、改名。

mc.q: Which permission on a file allows a .php file to be run?
mc.e: Execute runs executable files.

mc.q: Why are teachers not given Execute permission on the school file server?
o: To prevent unauthorised programs running on the server
To stop them reading exam papers
Because execute is needed only by students
mc.e: Book reason: prevent unauthorised programs.
mc.ez: 防止未授权程序在 server 执行。

mc.q: A student has no permissions at all on folder Exam_Result. What happens?
o: He can open files but not edit them
He cannot even see the folder
He can list the files but not open them
mc.e: With no rights the folder is not visible.
mc.ez: 无权限则看不到该文件夹。

mc.q: Which is an advantage of a file server over cloud storage?
o: Faster access speed within the LAN
mc.e: Within the LAN access is faster; others are cloud advantages.
mc.ez: LAN 内较快；其余是 cloud 优点。

mc.q: Which is an advantage of cloud storage over a file server?
o: Lower cost per storage unit in the long run
mc.e: Cloud storage is easy and quick to set up.

mc.q: The range of IP addresses that a DHCP server can assign is called the
mc.e: The administrator-defined range is the scope.

mc.q: A DHCP scope is 10.0.0.20 to 10.0.0.69. How many addresses can it assign?
What happens when a DHCP lease expires and the device is still online?
o: The device must request an IP again
The device keeps the IP forever
The device switches to a static IP automatically
mc.e: It must request again; unused expired IPs can be reclaimed.

mc.q: Which is a disadvantage of using a DHCP server?
o: It is a single point of failure
Settings must be configured on every device
mc.e: If it fails, devices cannot get IPs.
mc.ez: DHCP server 故障则拿不到 IP。

mc.q: Which information is NOT normally contained in a DHCP offer?
mc.e: Offers carry network configuration only.

mc.q: In DHCP discovery, the new computer first
o: broadcasts a DHCP message to all devices
asks the DNS server for the DHCP address
sends a unicast to the DHCP server's IP
mc.e: It does not know the server's IP, so it broadcasts.
mc.ez: 不知道 server IP，只能 broadcast。

mc.q:
Which TWO are functions of a domain controller?
(1) Login authentication (2) Content caching (3) User rights control (4) IP address assignment
mc.e: Caching is proxy; IP assignment is DHCP.
mc.ez: Caching 属 proxy，分配 IP 属 DHCP。

mc.q: A school applies the same screen-lock setting to all 300 computers at once. Which feature is used?
o: Group Policy of a domain controller
mc.e: Group Policies apply settings across the network.

mc.q: Students in a lab repeatedly download the same large files from one website. Which device best reduces waiting time and bandwidth use?
mc.e: Proxy content caching.

mc.q: When a proxy forwards a client's request to a website, the website sees
mc.e: The proxy sends an identical request using its own IP.
mc.ez: Proxy 用自己的 IP 发请求。

mc.q: Which HTTP header can stop a proxy server from caching a time-sensitive response?
mc.e: no-cache prevents caching.

mc.q: Which is a disadvantage of a proxy server?
o: It hides the client's IP address
mc.e: The others are advantages/functions.

mc.q: Which statement about a proxy server and a firewall is correct?
o: A proxy can fully replace a firewall
A proxy mainly blocks access to certain websites while a firewall protects against security threats
mc.e: They have different purposes and cannot replace each other.
mc.ez: 两者目的不同，不能互相取代。

mc.q: Using an untrusted public proxy mainly risks
mc.e: An untrusted proxy can intercept/tamper with traffic.
mc.ez: 不可信 proxy 可截取篡改流量。

mc.q: Which is NOT a disadvantage of a proxy server given in the book?
mc.e: The book says servers attach last-modified/expiry (or no-cache) headers, so outdated content is not a valid drawback.
mc.ez: 课本指出服务器有 expiry/no-cache header，过时内容不算缺点。

mc.q: Which statement about a print server is correct?
o: Print jobs are sent directly to each printer
Each printer must have a built-in Wi-Fi module
It allows sharing printers without built-in networking
mc.e: Printers can attach by USB etc.

mc.q: Which is a disadvantage of using many network printers in a large office?
o: They need a print server to work
They operate independently and are hard to manage
mc.e: Many independent network printers are hard to manage.

mc.q: Sharing one Internet connection in a home network mainly
o: saves cost since only one ISP subscription is needed
removes the need for a router
mc.e: One subscription for all devices.
mc.ez: 只需一个 ISP 订阅。

mc.q: To protect shared files against ransomware, backups should be stored
o: on a separate device or offsite
in the same folder as the files
mc.e: Separate/offsite backups and tested recovery.
mc.ez: 备份放另一设备或 offsite。

mc.q: A home user needs 10 Gbps over a 40 m cable. Which Ethernet category is suitable?
mc.e: Cat 6 supports 10 Gbps up to 55 m.
mc.ez: Cat 6 在 55 m 内有 10 Gbps。

mc.q: What is the maximum throughput of a Cat 5 cable?
mc.e: Cat 5: 100 Mbps, 100 m.

mc.q: Most home subscribers connect to their ISP using
mc.e: ISP authenticates username/password and assigns an IP.

mc.q: In PPPoE, the username and password provided by the ISP are entered into
mc.e: They go into the router configuration.
mc.ez: 输入 router 的 Internet configuration。

mc.q: Why should a network printer be given a static IP address?
o: So its address does not change and computers can always find it
Because DHCP cannot assign IP to printers
mc.e: Static IP does not change.

mc.q: An integrated home router usually combines
mc.e: Book: router + switch + access point.

mc.q: Which is the best place for a home access point?
o: In the corner furthest from the bedrooms
A central location away from thick walls
mc.e: Central and away from interference.

mc.q: SSID stands for
mc.e: Service Set Identifier is the Wi-Fi network name.

mc.q: A dual-band router uses
mc.e: Dual-band = 2.4 GHz + 5 GHz.

mc.q: Which Wi-Fi standard is Wi-Fi 6?
In a simple home network, which device connects wired PCs inside the LAN?
mc.e: The switch connects wired devices via Ethernet.

sq.q: A school hosts its website at https://school.edu. A teacher later sets up a second web server for testing that is reached at https://school.edu:8443.

parts.q: What does 8443 represent?
parts.ms:
Suggested answer:
The port number of the (testing) web server / application.

parts.q: Explain why the original URL does not need a number.
parts.ms: HTTPS uses default port 443; when no port is specified the request is sent to the protocol's default port.

parts.q: Give TWO reasons, other than testing, why a service may run on a non-default port.
parts.ms:
Any two, with explanation:
Port conflict: default port occupied by another application.
Security: obfuscates the service from attackers.
Firewall restrictions block the default port.
Multiple instances of the same service.

sq.q: A school file server has folders Public, ICT and Exam_Result.

parts.q: Distinguish between Read permission on a file and Read permission on a folder.
parts.ms:
File Read: can open/read the content of the file.
Folder Read: can only list the names of files/sub-folders; reading a file's content also needs Read on that file.

parts.q: Suggest suitable rights for a student on Exam_Result and a teacher on ICT, with reasons.
parts.ms:
Student: no rights on Exam_Result, so cannot see the folder / results of others.
Teacher: Read and Write on ICT, so can add, delete and edit teaching files.

parts.q: Why should Execute permission not be granted to teachers and students?
parts.ms: To prevent unauthorised programs/scripts from running on the file server.

sq.q: A co-working office uses a DHCP server and a domain controller.

parts.q: Describe how a new laptop obtains an IP address from the DHCP server, including the term lease.
parts.ms:
Laptop broadcasts a DHCP discovery message.
DHCP server replies with a DHCP offer (IP, subnet mask, gateway, DNS); laptop sends DHCP request and is assigned an unused IP from the scope.
The IP is leased for a fixed duration; must request again / reclaimed after expiry.

parts.q: State one advantage and one disadvantage of DHCP.
parts.ms:
Advantage: automatic assignment avoids IP conflicts / human error; centralised management; faster setup.
Disadvantage: single point of failure.

parts.q: State two advantages of using a domain controller.
parts.ms: Any two: centralised user and resource management; improved security via authentication and authorisation; Group Policy management.

sq.q: A media classroom installs a proxy server.

parts.q: Explain how content caching shortens the loading time when 30 students open the same web page.
parts.ms:
First request is intercepted; proxy sends an identical request with its own IP.
Response forwarded to the student and a copy cached locally.
Later identical requests answered directly from the cache without going to the Internet/web server.

parts.q: A teacher says the proxy may serve outdated pages. Explain how this is handled.
parts.ms:
Web server adds last-modified / expiry headers stating how long the proxy may cache.
Time-sensitive responses carry a no-cache header so they are not cached.

parts.q: Is a firewall still needed? Explain.
parts.ms:
Yes.
A firewall protects the network from security threats, while a proxy mainly caches and blocks certain websites; they cannot replace each other.

sq.q: A family sets up a home network.

parts.q: Explain how the router connects to the ISP using PPPoE.
parts.ms:
ISP gives username and password, entered into the router's Internet configuration.
ISP authenticates the credentials and assigns an IP address; devices access the Internet through the router.

parts.q: Suggest two factors to consider when setting up the Wi-Fi.
parts.ms: Any two: central access point placement away from walls/metal/microwaves; newer standard e.g. Wi-Fi 6; custom SSID and strong password; dual-band 2.4/5 GHz.

parts.q: Compare using a network printer with using a print server for this home.
parts.ms:
Network printer connects directly with its own IP, easy to set up/maintain, suitable for a home.
Print server centrally manages multiple printers; unnecessary for one printer and adds cost.

sq.q: Mr Lee runs an online tuck-shop ordering system. Students visit https://tuck.school.hk, and a PHP script reads and writes orders in a MySQL database on another machine.

parts.q: State the port numbers used by (i) the students' browsers to reach the web server and (ii) the PHP script to reach MySQL.
parts.ms:
Suggested answer:
(i) 443 (HTTPS)
(ii) 3306 (MySQL)

parts.q: Describe the role of the web server when a student views her order history.
parts.ms:
Receives/handles the HTTP request; runs the server-side (PHP) script to generate the page dynamically.
Returns an HTTP response with status code, content type and HTML body.

parts.q: Suggest TWO security measures for the database server.
parts.ms:
User authentication: the script's account needs username/password.
User access control: give the script's account only the privileges it needs (e.g. no DROP).

sq.q: A small design studio of 8 staff must choose between a file server in the office and cloud storage for its shared files.

parts.q: Give TWO advantages of cloud storage for the studio.
parts.ms:
Easy and quick to set up / low initial cost.
Access from anywhere with Internet (e.g. staff working from home).
Easy to scale up.

parts.q: Give TWO advantages of a file server.
parts.ms:
Faster access within the LAN (large design files).
Lower cost per storage unit in the long run / no subscription fee.

parts.q: Whichever is used, state two considerations to protect the shared files.
parts.ms: Any two: user authentication and access control (least permissions); keep OS/software updated; regular backups to separate device/offsite with tested recovery (e.g. against ransomware).

sq.q: A school library network has 120 computers. It currently uses static IP addresses typed in by technicians, and 4 printers (2 are USB-only) each connected to one computer.

parts.q: Suggest a network service to replace manually typed IP addresses and give two benefits.
parts.ms:
DHCP server.
Automatic assignment reduces IP conflicts / human error.
Centralised management of subnet mask, gateway, DNS / faster setup.

parts.q: Which devices should still keep static IP addresses? Explain.
parts.ms: Servers/network printers (shared devices), so their address does not change and other computers can always find them.

parts.q: Recommend how to share the 4 printers and justify.
parts.ms:
Use a print server: USB-only printers without built-in networking can be shared.
Jobs are dispatched to available printers and status is monitored centrally.

parts.q: The DHCP scope is 172.16.0.11 to 172.16.0.130. Is it large enough? Show working.
parts.ms:
130 − 11 + 1 = 120 addresses.
Exactly 120: enough only if every computer is online at once with nothing else; it leaves no spare addresses, so a larger scope is advisable.

pr.t: Find the destination port of a URL
pr.tz: 找出 URL 的目的端口
pr.task: Write a function dest_port(url) that returns the destination port (an int) of a URL of the form scheme://host[:port][/path]. If a port is written after the host, return it. Otherwise return the default port: http → 80, https → 443, ftp → 21.
pr.taskz: 写函数 dest_port(url)，返回 URL 的目的端口（int）。host 后写了端口就返回它，否则按协议返回默认端口：http 80、https 443、ftp 21。

pr.tz: 计算 DHCP scope 大小
pr.task: A DHCP scope is given by its first and last IPv4 address (same network, e.g. '192.168.0.96' to '192.168.0.200'). Write scope_size(first, last) that returns how many addresses the scope contains (inclusive). Your function must also work when the scope crosses a third-octet boundary, e.g. 10.0.0.250 to 10.0.1.5.
pr.taskz: 写 scope_size(first, last)，返回 DHCP scope 包含多少个地址（首尾都计）。要能处理跨第三段的情况，如 10.0.0.250 到 10.0.1.5。

pr.task: Using the book's table (Cat 5: 100 Mbps up to 100 m; Cat 5E: 1 Gbps up to 100 m; Cat 6: 1 Gbps up to 100 m, 10 Gbps up to 55 m), write choose_cable(mbps, metres) returning the lowest category string that meets both the speed and the length: 'Cat 5', 'Cat 5E', 'Cat 6', or 'None' if none can.
pr.taskz: 根据书中表格，写 choose_cable(mbps, metres)，返回同时满足速度和长度的最低类别：'Cat 5'、'Cat 5E'、'Cat 6'，都不行则 'None'。
